- New skill to query TripAdvisor location data (search, details, photos, reviews) directly from the shell using the Terra REST API via curl.
- Supports both API-key-protected Terra endpoints and a no-API-key fallback using the fpx browser bridge for public page data.
- Designed as an alternative to running tripadvisor-mcp, useful for scripting and environments without MCP installed.
- Includes clear setup, usage guidance, and error handling details for both Terra API and browser bridge fallback.
- Triggers on "check TripAdvisor" and any TripAdvisor data request to hit the API directly.
